There has been some speculation about TK being a closet leftist.  As I
pointed out in earlier posts, liberals just can't bear to hear the fact that
they are no longer political outcasts; they are mainstream.  They are
especially irritated by the fact that someone like TK, as intellectually
gifted as he was, and breaking the rules, laws, etc., could have exalted
nature and excoriated them at the same time in his manifesto.  They see
everything as black and white, i.e., if you are a right-winger it means you
are religious, only have sex in the missionary position, are against
environmental conservation, etc.  And they accuse others of stereotyping!

Okay, perhaps TK wasn't a fascist, but one thing comes clear in his
manifesto, if nothing else: He HATES leftists.  He hates them.  He wants
them to have no part in the revolution.  Does that make him a National
Socialist?  No, of course not.  Interestingly, he spent more the manifesto
bashing PC'ers than Nazis!

He succinctly describes his views on leftists in this sentence:

"...a movement that exalts nature and opposes technology must take a
resolutely anti-leftist stance and must avoid all collaboration with
leftists."
